title: Triangle inequality for disagreement indicators
statement:
For all real numbers $a,b,c$, the indicator of $a
e c$ is at most the sum of the indicators of $a
e b$ and $b
e c$; here each indicator is $1$ when its condition holds and $0$ otherwise.
